lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; the project's line 4a (s1.line5) and the reply's (s1.line3 + s1.line5) differ only by Schedule 1 line 3, business income. i8960 p. 8, Line 4a, has Schedule 1 lines 3, 5 and 6 entered, and line 4b then adjusts out 'income or loss from a trade or business that's not a passive activity' (the section 162 nonpassive business), so for an active Schedule C or farm business lines 4a and 4b net to zero on lines 3 and 6 and line 4c equals the project's. Any other business or pass-through income (passive business, K-1) is refused through f8960.unsupported ('annuity, business or pass-through income', refusing 'when Form 8960 is required') on every line 4a through 8 reads. Triage 2,523/3,008 agree; 485 differ, all with s1.line3 nonzero and the gate answered No; the completed witnesses checked (stage14.asset.hy_5yr, Schedule C $50,000; stage5.return.refund_f8960_refund_unused, AGI $130,000) file no Form 8960 (f8960.used: AGI not over the $200,000 threshold), so line 4a is not on the return. The reply's own note says business income is refused, then adds line 3 anyway.

Ruling: model error (+ scope); i8960 p. 16, Part II, the deductions that may be allocated to NII include "Certain taxes under section 164(a) reported as itemized deductions, if properly deducted on your return when calculating your U.S. regular income tax"; pp. 17–18, Line 9b—State, Local, and Foreign Income Tax: "You can determine the portion ... allocable to NII using any reasonable method." The candidate copies f8960.allocated_taxes on every return; the project enters it only when the filer itemizes (sa.itemizes) and $0 otherwise, and refuses through f8960.bad_allocation when the claimed allocation exceeds Schedule A line 5e. executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/f8960.json`, pass 8768ac16f4ce, regenerated this round; 1,702 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 111 partial records from 40 bases; 2,313 comparisons; completed witnesses listed in full by a scratch rerun): 1,571 of 2,313 agree; 583 project-refuses, 129 candidate-unknown, 30 project-unknown; on completed returns 84 candidate-unknown, all non-itemizers where the project shows $0.00 without reading the allocation (e.g. classm.f2441.1: sa.itemizes No; the interview does not ask f8960.allocated_taxes there): the candidate needs an answer the source does not need, since a non-itemizer has no such deduction (model error). The 1 completed project-refuses is stage5.return.itemized_f8960_allocation_unused (allocation $999,999.99 against Schedule A line 5e $10,000.00; f8960.bad_allocation, cited i8960 pp. 17–18), a validity screen on a return that does not file Form 8960 (line 17 $0.00, Form 1040 line 24 $10,657.00 in both trees): scope. The other project-refuses are refusals reaching the line from other forms on refused returns. Gate wave (BUG-0471): f8960.bad_allocation is a choose on sa.itemizes then f8960.allocation_over_5e, the HEAD `all`'s truth table; line 9b is the same in HEAD and the working tree on every completed fixture and generated return; it differs only on classm.asset.3 (refused in both trees), where the line refuses at oi8z[item_a].figured in HEAD and is unknown in the working tree, the incomplete-state difference BUG-0471 records. Project stands.

Ruling: model error on the declaration, ruled mechanically: the reply fails the host's schema, type or reference validation on this line or a line it reads (f8960.line13: "f8960.f8960.line13: reference 'f1040.line11' does not resolve"), so the line was not executed. This adjudicates the declaration, not the tax reading.

Ruling: model error; i8960 p. 1, "Attach Form 8960 to your return if your modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) is greater than the applicable threshold amount"; f8960 p. 1, line 16, "Enter the smaller of line 12 or line 15". The candidate's smaller of lines 12 and 15 is the project's amount on every return (with MAGI, which is AGI in scope, not above line 14, line 15 is $0 and both give $0; no value difference). It figures line 12 on every return, so it asks or refuses on the Form 8960 screens (f8960.unsupported, f8960.refund, f8960.allocated_taxes) of filers who do not file the form, answers the source does not need; the project gates line 12 on the new f8960.used (BUG-0401). Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f8960.json`, refresh round; 1,565 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 121 partial records): 908 of 2,186 agree; on completed returns 202 candidate-unknown, 16 candidate-refuses, no value. No error introduced by BUG-0401: f8960.used compares sa.agi (Form 1040 line 11b) with line 14, the same comparison line 15 makes from line 13.
